PC Power 603 Wired Keyboard – Ideal for Bangla Typing and Office Work

Boost your productivity with the PC Power 603 Wired Office Keyboard, designed for smooth and efficient typing with both English and Bangla characters. This full-size wired keyboard features a reliable and durable build, ideal for everyday office work, data entry, and general computer use.

Equipped with a Bangla dual-language layout, the PC Power 603 makes it easy to switch between English and Bangla typing seamlessly. The sturdy keys offer a comfortable typing experience with responsive feedback to enhance your workflow. Its plug-and-play USB connection ensures quick setup with no driver installation required.

Perfect for professionals, students, and anyone who needs a dependable keyboard with Bangla support.


Key Features:

  • Full-size wired keyboard with Bangla and English dual layout
  • Durable keys designed for long-lasting daily use
  • Comfortable and responsive typing experience
  • Plug-and-play USB connection, compatible with Windows and macOS
  • Ideal for office work, data entry, and general computing
  • Sleek, ergonomic design for comfortable extended use
